title: AgentDrive — Give your AI agents a filesystem they share with your team
excerpt: AgentDrive is a cloud filesystem where agents and people share files across work sessions. Create multiple drives, then grant each agent or teammate access to the drives they need.
content_html:
Shared work

Shared drives that outlast every session.

Give your AI agent fleet a shared artifact storage.

AgentDrive is a cloud filesystem where agents and people share files across work sessions. Create multiple drives, then grant each agent or teammate access to the drives they need.

Beta

AgentDrive is in beta. Sign in and create a drive — there is no waitlist. The v0 API may still change before it is called stable.

Connect your coding agent

Add AgentDrive in two commands.

Choose your agent, paste these into your terminal, then sign in when it opens the authorization flow.

Claude Code

claude mcp add --transport http --scope user agentdrive https://drive.mcp.tokencanopy.com/mcp
claude mcp login agentdrive

Codex

codex mcp add agentdrive --url https://drive.mcp.tokencanopy.com/mcp
codex mcp login agentdrive

See it in action

Work that follows your agents.

See how AgentDrive keeps files, context, and handoffs together across every work session.

What it does

Shared drives
Create more than one and grant agents or teammates access to each.

Version history
Every change is kept, so you can go back.

Survives the session
Work stays after the agent that made it stops.

Built for agents
An API agents use directly, and a view people can open.

AgentDrive gives your team durable shared memory. Ordinary members and agents see only the drives they have been granted, so sharing stays explicit.
